fixed: 2026-09-30, before any scoring on the evaluation sets

bank.built_by: eval/build_semantic_bank.py (layer 1 rules + development scam chat only)

messages: a labelled line ('Owner: ' / 'Renter: ') plus its unlabelled continuation lines; only Owner messages are matched
similarity: cosine between L2-normalised embeddings; a message's score for a tactic is its highest similarity to any of that tactic's examples
threshold: per tactic and model: the highest score that tactic reaches on any Owner message of a LEGITIMATE conversation in data/processed/random train+val, plus 0.01 - i.e. no false alarm on that data by construction
semantic_flag: a conversation carries tactic k if any Owner message scores >= threshold_k

evaluation.pairs: data/processed/augmented/minimal_pairs_test.csv, full conversations (72 pairs, wording never in training)
real: real scam chat (development chat; the bank was drawn from it - not independent)
real iBilik chat: current OCR, pre-fix OCR, hand transcript

model_choice: on the minimal-pair results with layer 1 + semantic: (1) fewer legitimate twins flagged, (2) more of the layer-1-missed scam twins caught, (3) less CPU time. The author asked for the choice to use these results, which makes the chosen model's numbers slightly optimistic (a choice between two).

adopt_if_all.a: the semantic flags catch >= ceil(half) of the scam twins layer 1 misses
adopt_if_all.b: legitimate twins flagged by layer 1 + semantic <= those flagged by layer 1 alone
adopt_if_all.c: no semantic flag on any version of the real iBilik chat

baseline: conversation vector = mean of all its message embeddings (both speakers); sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=2000); trained on random/train.csv + run 1's minimal_pairs_train (rebuilt exactly by eval/run2_data_comparison.py), the data run 1 was trained on; threshold 0.5; scored on random/val.csv and the minimal-pair test full conversations
cpu_time: per chat, with the embedding cache emptied first: embed its Owner messages and compare with the bank
